notes.title: Update V.0.0.7 – New Loot, System Tweaks & Interactive NPC
notes.content:
[h2]🆕 Content & Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new [b]NPC with a gambling mini-game[/b].
[*] [b]More loot points[/b] added in Volygrad.
[*] [b]New lootable item models[/b] added to the world.
[*] Updated and added [b]new resources[/b] with their own [b]icons[/b].
[/list]

[h2]⚙️ System & UI Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The [b]keyboard layout now auto-switches[/b] to QWERTY or AZERTY depending on your system language.
[*] [b]Skill progress bars[/b] redesigned, along with [b]new skill icons[/b].
[*] [b]Accessory icons[/b] completely reworked.
[*] Changed the [b]position of dialogue display[/b] for better readability.
[/list]

[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes & Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a [b]misplaced loot point[/b] in the infirmary.
[*] [b]Moved a shelf[/b] in an HLM building that was blocking a path.
[*] Fixed stamina drain bug when using tap-to-sprint: [b]stamina no longer drains when standing still[/b].
[/list]

[h2]📉 Balance & Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Volygrad raid cost[/b] increased from 100 back to 200 Zeds.
[*] [b]Various internal parameters adjusted[/b] to improve game performance.
[/list]

[b]Thanks for all your feedback on the forums and Discord!

👉 Version 0.0.7 strengthens the world’s coherence and lays the foundation for future progression mechanics in Z Ops Deadzone.[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.0.6 – Attachments, polish, and the foundation for what's next
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.0.6 – Attachments, polish, and the foundation for what's next[/h1]
[h2]One step closer to a deeper, clearer, and more strategic experience[/h2]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added weapon attachment system and a modification table.
[*] Attachments now affect the stats of equipped weapons.
[*] Added error sound in the shop when purchase or sale is not possible.
[*] Added sound in the raid menu if the player doesn't have enough money.
[*] Display of ammo type used by the current weapon added to the main UI.
[*] Adjusted position and size of weapon info in the main UI.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the color of the P9 for better visual distinction.
[*] Zombie hearing distance reduced from 6500 to 6000 units.
[*] Minimum distance required between a player and a spawn point to activate zombie spawning increased to 2500 units.
[*] Fixed footstep sounds.
[*] New interaction system:
    - Outline becomes visible when the object enters the player's crosshair.
    - A prompt with the key and "Interact" appears on screen.
[*] Added a wall to prevent players from leaving the colony area.
[*] Reduced the size of the player capsule.
[/list]

[h2]Coming Soon...[/h2]
[list]
[*] A major rework of the colony and Volygrad is underway – plans are already finalized.
[*] Survival mechanics will be expanded: more resources to manage and new player needs to monitor.
[*] Human AI enemies will start appearing in the open world – get ready for more intense encounters.
[/list]

[b]Thanks for all your feedback on the forums and Discord!  
👉 Update 0.0.6 sets the stage for the next big steps in Z Ops Deadzone.[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.0.5.1 – Fixes, Feedback & Polish
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay & Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved locomotion animations for smoother transitions.
[*] Added sound effect when zombies are knocked back.
[*] Added a notification when a quest is completed.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the pause menu disabling when opening the options tab.
[*] Fixed ZAR automatic fire audio bug when firing a full magazine.
[*] Removed balcony doors that could block the player.
[/list]
[b]Thanks again for your feedback on the forums and Discord!  
👉 More improvements are coming in the next update![/b]

notes.title: Update 0.0.5 – Optimization, gameplay comfort, and visual improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay & Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Testing a new recoil system for shooting animations (still in experimental phase).
[*] Added custom movement options: ability to toggle "Hold" mode for Crouch / Walk / Run / Aim.
[*] Conditions added for aiming to avoid certain aiming-related bugs.
[*] Raid cost for Volygrad reduced from 200 to 100 Zeds.
[*] Loot outline visibility distance increased to 1.5m for all items.
[/list]
[h2]Interface & Visibility[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enlarged conversation UI for better reading comfort.
[*] Loot outlines made more visible (increased thickness).
[*] Darkened the background of the options menu for better readability.
[/list]
[h2]Graphics & Performance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Return of 2048px textures for environment objects for a more detailed look.
[*] Reenabled Nanite for better detail rendering at distance.
[*] Improved player capsule collisions: now limits cases where the camera would pass through walls.
[/list]
[b]Thank you for your feedback on the forums and Discord! Keep reporting bugs and sharing your ideas.
👉 Next update planned with even more content![/b]

notes.title: Update 0.0.4 – Improvements and Adjustments
notes.content:
[h1]Tutorial[/h1]
[list]  
[*] Added tutorial in the colony.  
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]  
[*] Reduced "Out of Breath" delay.  
[*] New games now start with 1000 Zeds.  
[*] The player now recovers their mask, but it will be invisible when aiming with the ZAR-1.  
[*] Changed subtitle placement and size.  
[*] Collisions with the watchtower have been fixed.  
[/list]

[h1]Loot[/h1]
[list]  
[*] New loot on car chests.  
[*] Moved a spawn point that was inside a barrel.  
[/list]

[h1]Performance and Optimizations[/h1]
[list]  
[*] Disabled Nanine & Lumen.  
[*] Reduced the texture size of all environmental objects to 1024.  
[*] Added a barrier inside a building.  
[*] Now, the game pauses when you open the pause HUD.  
[/list]

[h1]Endurance and Combat[/h1]
[list]  
[*] You can now gain endurance from melee attacks.  
[*] Adjusted endurance consumption based on the melee attack skill.  
[/list]

[h3]🔥 Download the update and try out all these improvements now![/h3]

notes.title: Update 0.0.3 – Colony Expansion & Gameplay Balance
notes.content:
[h1]Colony[/h1]  
[list]  
[*] Added tomatoes and corn to the gardens.  
[*] Added an emergency medical zone, preparing for a future paid medical service.  
[*] Added a garage for future functionality expansions.  
[*] Added a supply point, setting up future donation mechanics for the colony.  
[*] Added a campfire to enhance atmosphere and survival (interactions & NPCs coming soon).  
[*] Added a drinking area for relaxation (interactions & NPCs coming soon).  
[*] Added guard soldiers to reinforce the colony’s security.  
[*] Added a merchant behind the shop counter.  
[/list]  
[h1]Zombies[/h1]  
[list]  
[*] Reduced the spawn rate of Bane-Z from 25% to 15%, making them rarer but still dangerous.  
[/list]  
[h1]Loot[/h1]  
[list]  
[*] Adjusted maximum resource values to better balance progression and inventory management.  
[/list]  
[h1]Death & Respawn[/h1]  
[list]  
[*] Fixed an issue where stacks were not updating after death.  
[*] Increased health on respawn from 25 to 35 for a less punishing restart.  
[/list]  
[h1]Player Character[/h1]  
[list]  
[*] Updated unarmed movement animations (further refinements coming for improved fluidity).  
[/list]  
[h1]Volygrad[/h1]  
[list]  
[*] Added new loot spawn points to encourage exploration.  
[*] Added a street football field for a more diverse environment.  
[*] Increased zombie spawn delay across all points for better gameplay balance.  
[*] Opened the ground floor of a building, offering new exploration opportunities.  
[/list]  
[h3]🔥 Download the update now and experience all the new improvements![/h3]

notes.title: 🛠️ Update 0.0.2.5 – Improvements & New Features! 🎯
notes.content:
[b]🆕 New Features & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added to credits 🎤: Gabriel Nozak, the voice actor and UI designer, is now officially credited.
[*] Colony rework 🏕️: Preparations for its future development.
[*] Gabriel Nozak’s face update 🧑: New facial animations when he speaks.
[*] Aiming animation improvements 🔫:
[*] Adjustments for the P9 pistol and ZAR-1 assault rifle.
[*] New colony restriction 🚫: Players can no longer shoot inside the colony.
[*] New zombie models added 🧟: More variety in the infected!
[*] New health & stamina UI 💉: Redesigned for better readability.
[/list]
[b]🎧 Audio Enhancements[/b]

[list]
[*] Player now makes a sound when taking damage 🔊.
[*] New zombie sounds added 🗣️: More immersion!
[*] Added sounds for bandage application 🩹.
[*] Fixed default values for audio settings 🎛️.
[/list]

This update lays the groundwork for the future of the game and enhances the overall player experience. Thank you for your support and feedback—keep sharing your thoughts with us!

See you in Z Ops Deadzone 🧟‍♂️🔥

notes.title: Major Update – Complete Overhaul with Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
[b][h2]Content of the Update:[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Upgrade to Unreal Engine 5:[/b] A major technological leap that improves graphics, lighting, and game performance. Enjoy a smoother and more immersive experience.
[*][b]Complete User Interface Overhaul:[/b] A clearer and more intuitive design for easier navigation.
[/list]

[b][h3]New Features:[/h3][/b]

[list]
[*][b]New Melee Weapon:[/b] The baseball bat! Can be used for close combat attacks, with endurance management and the option to block.
[*][b]Push Action:[/b] Push zombies or other characters with any equipped weapon.
[*][b]New Animation for the ZAR-1:[/b] More fluidity and realism in the weapon's movements.
[*][b]New Zombie Movement Animation:[/b] More natural and impactful movements for a better experience.
[*][b]Bandage Application Animation Added:[/b] Apply your bandages with a new immersive animation.
[/list]

[b][h3]Improvements:[/h3][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Locker Overhaul:[/b] Improved organization and management of stored items.
[*][b]Shop Overhaul:[/b] You can now purchase weapons. Price adjustments and changes to the sale of resources (now selling for 50 units instead of 100).
[*][b]Loot System Modified:[/b] Improved distribution of lootable items, with adjustments to the frequency and variety of found items.
[/list]

[b][h3]New Content:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Added NPC Gabriel Nozak:[/b] A new key character who will give you interesting quests to enrich your adventure.
[*][b]First Quest Given by Gabriel Nozak:[/b] Embark on the quest offered by this character to begin an exciting series of missions.
[/list]
